svg.title: Yuyuan Han. How optical measurements shape what machines can infer. PhD student, Xi'an Jiaotong University.
svg.desc: Synthetic concept illustration: sparse optical samples and a fine luminous trace lead into a schematic brain volume with seven tomography slices. Inspired by time-domain diffuse optical tomography for 3D brain imaging. The signals and anatomy are drawn, not measured data or a clinical reconstruction.
